definitions.explanation: A tax imposed on goods when they are transported across international borders, typically collected by customs authorities.

examples.japanese: {関税|かんぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}→輸入品：11505_yunyuuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{関税|かんぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Customs duties apply to imported goods.

examples.japanese: {関税|かんぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧から⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Because the tariff is high, the price goes up when you buy from overseas.

notes:
{関税|かんぜい} is a tax levied on goods crossing international borders, commonly encountered in news about trade policy.

FORMS:
{関|かん} (barrier/checkpoint) + {税|ぜい} (tax)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関税|かんぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: customs duties apply
- {関税|かんぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay tariffs
- {関税|かんぜい}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: tariff rate
- {関税|かんぜい}⟦{撤廃|てっぱい}→撤廃：12911_teppai⟧: tariff elimination
- {関税|かんぜい}⟦{障壁|しょうへき}→障壁：14536_shouheki⟧: tariff barrier
- {関税|かんぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to impose a tariff

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{税関|ぜいかん}→税関：04380_zeikan⟧: customs office (note the reversed character order)
- ⟦{輸入税|ゆにゅうぜい}→輸入税：noentry⟧: import tax
- ⟦{免税|めんぜい}→免税：09706_menzei⟧: duty-free
